[nation]Akhratia[/nation]

As has been pointed out to you before (https://i.ibb.co/FkyX8TTR/Untitled.png), [b]you are over the GDP limit for starting nations.[/b] Just as you said yourself, our priority is for everyone in our community to have fun. However, everyone has differing ideas and levels to what they call fun. There is easily over 50 individual people on the map, so you can imagine that it is [b]virtually impossible to cater to everyones idea of fun[/b] without arguments and petty disputes erupting. Thats why we have [b]rules[/b]. By having these rules, we keep everyone at a level playing field, since most can agree that having 30+ American level GDPs and Militaries is very fun for the whole community.

So, [b]please lower your GDP to the maximum of $1 trillion[/b]. While you have done some world building in regard to your economy, it is not sufficient enough to justify having $3.7 trillion. Once you bring your GDP down to $1 trillion, then we can get to work on adding your expansion to the map which will give a little boost to your GDP. After that, there are other ways to increase your GDP without expanding your nation, such as world building and interactions with other roleplayers. There are plenty of people here that know about economics and would be willing to help you so long as you ask.
